items.text: Cardinals trading Marvin Harrison Jr. (and 7th) to Texans for 2027 2nd and 6th. MHJ inactive for ARI Week 5.
items.why: Blockbuster confirmed with Schefter; fresh start with Stroud.
items.implication: MHJ value reset in HOU behind Nico; ARI WRs (Wilson) boost immediate.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson/Kendrick Bourne target surge ARI; MHJ long-term HOU upside.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.opportunity: Increased work for other HOU RBs.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play; Terry McLaurin will play. From GTD. Projections live.
items.why: Pregame workout clearance and final reports.
items.implication: Jeanty start-worthy but monitor workload on ankle/foot; McLaurin viable.
items.opportunity: Jeanty carries/routes if full; McLaurin targets with Daniels back.

items.text: ETR final updates: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play (from prior uncertainty/Q). Projections updated.
items.why: Weekend reports and final AM updates cleared both.
items.implication: Start both confidently in favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected for WR1/WR2 duo.

items.text: Justin Jefferson expected to play/active; Jordan Addison not expected/inactive. From GTD pair.
items.why: Final updates and Rapoport confirmation; Jefferson wanted to play home.
items.implication: Start Jefferson; Addison out boosts Jefferson target share.
items.opportunity: Jefferson snap/route share up without Addison.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs best salary-adjusted value by big margin despite high price; only 61.5% owned in DK cash. Must-play in cash review.
items.why: Projections showed elite value; underowned for chalk.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target share in Lions offense.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. out for remainder of game due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; short-term target bump to others.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining SF WRs/TE.

items.text: Jaylen Warren passes every test (advanced stats, eye test); Ekeler-esque. Insane coaching refused workhorse role until Dowdle injury.
items.why: Dowdle out (toe/inactive); Warren thrives in expanded role.
items.implication: Start Warren confidently as RB1/2 while Dowdle sidelined.
items.opportunity: High carries, routes, third-down, goal-line with Dowdle out.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive but has a chance to play next week.
items.implication: Bears backup QB; Swift/others unaffected much.

items.text: NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY: Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, others. McConkey later active but limited/no meaningful snaps.
items.why: Weekend practice reports and final statuses; MHJ trade-related inactive.
items.implication: Avoid or handcuff; McConkey risk even if active.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries: Tre Harris (LAC), backups for others; Michael Wilson/Bourne (ARI).

items.text: Holy hell what a TD catch by Trey McBride.
Zay Flowers officially active tonight (vs Falcons).
Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for GB RB depth/upside.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded role if Jacobs limited.

items.text: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson (concussion) downgraded to out.
items.implication: Vikings TE void; Jefferson more volume.
items.opportunity: Slight bump to other MIN pass-catchers.
